title: AutoNeural: Co-Designing Vision-Language Models for NPU Inference
selection_reason: AutoNeural co-designs an NPU-native VLM: a MobileNetV5-style encoder with bounded activations for stable INT4/8/16 integer-only inference and an SSM-hybrid language backbone that removes KV-cache memory I/O during generation.
